title: Cluster federation learning realization method and system with feature alignment
assignee: Chongqing Academy of Science and Technology

pse.problem: Data heterogeneity in federated learning hinders the generalization ability of each cluster model and affects final model accuracy.
pse.solution_function: The system performs cluster federated learning with feature alignment, which includes training local models on client's private data sets, knowledge transfer through global model update, spectral clustering of clients, and weighted aggregation of cluster models to form a global model.
pse.solution_structure: The key components include clients with local models, servers for aggregating client models, and spectral clustering method as part of the server.
pse.solution_implementation: In each round, clients train their local models, update them by incorporating the global model (feature alignment), upload the weight updates to the server. The server performs spectral clustering on the uploaded data, evaluates clustering results using Calinski-Harabasz index, selects the best result, aggregates cluster models to form a global model, and sends it back to clients for further iterations.
pse.effect: The proposed method improves generalization ability by sharing knowledge between clusters through feature alignment, and mitigates errors caused by incorrect clustering evaluations.
